name: tracework
description: Evidence-backed work memory for agent sessions: capture what happened, replay why, and roll work into briefs, reviews, and roadmaps.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-backed work memory for agent sessions
interface.longDescription: Capture agent-session goals, decisions, rejected paths, risks, evidence, and next steps, then reuse them for recall, decision replay, work briefs, reviews, and roadmaps.
defaultPrompt: Use Tracework to capture this session with /tracework:capture.
Use Tracework to recall recent work context with /tracework:recall.
Use Tracework to query cited decision evidence with /tracework:query.
